exclusion_criteria: No post-hoc run exclusions. A run is invalid only for a logged execution/data-integrity failure defined before analysis.
stopping_rule: Execute the frozen context-control-model grid once after tests pass; corrections require a versioned manifest and full rerun.
ground_truth_access_rule: Estimator and baseline fitting code may not read benchmark ground_truth directories. Scoring code may read them after predictions/effects are frozen.
predictive_baseline_correction: Risk-only baselines use prospective context/control-plan features only; realized human/process/technical states removed after fairness audit.
parameter_separation: Estimator receives topology-only configs; true simulator coefficients are stored under simulator/world_configs and excluded from retained estimator code paths.
